notes.title: Hotfix: GPU performance leak
notes.content:
Hello!

This is a small update to tell you the GPU performance leak that was in the game was fixed. [b]The game will no longer take up to 100% of your GPU[/b] for no reason.

Thanks and sorry for the inconvenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41249375/0736c067fab40555e5a787f31c231ae9a979e1db.gif[/img]
